**Major documentation update and restructuring:**
- Revamped SKILL.md for improved readability with clear sectioning, overview table, workflow steps, and multi-language support.
- Added feature summaries, trigger conditions, and strict API/data retrieval rules in more explicit tabular format.
- Enhanced clarity on system/user boundaries, identity handling, and output requirements.
- Expanded examples and resource index for easier developer reference.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md for consistency.

- User identity handling is now fully automatic; users are no longer asked to provide or input any identity information.
- All requirements for user-supplied open-id, username, or mobile number have been removed from both workflow and documentation.
- Internal authentication and user association are now silently managed by the system and are never exposed in outputs or error messages.
- Updated examples and documentation for simplified API usage—users only need to provide video input; all identity processing is handled internally.
- Removed scripts and documentation files related to manual identity and open-id handling.

Version 1.0.1

- Updated skill version to 1.0.2 and added license information (MIT-0).
- Documentation improvements and minor clarifications in SKILL.md; no code logic changed.
- Removed obsolete file skill-card.md.
- No functional updates; compatibility and interface remain unchanged.

- Initial release of the pet pica behavior recognition and analysis skill.
- Supports detection of pet mouth contact with hazardous non-food items (e.g. electric wires, plastic bags, socks, tissues, toy fragments) in indoor camera videos.
- Triggers warning signals when contact lasts ≥ 2 seconds, helping to prevent intestinal obstruction, electric shock, and related dangers.
- Allows both local video uploads and network URL inputs for analysis via server-side APIs.
- Provides strict open-id acquisition and verification process for user identification and secure report management.
- Includes automatic historical report queries and Markdown-formatted results with direct viewing links.
